description: RavenPy is a Python interface for configuring and running the Raven hydrological modelling framework. The Canadian Hydrological Society and Canadian Water Resources Association contributors publish helpers for generating Raven text configuration, preparing grid weights, estimating watershed parameters and parsing model output. Inputs are watershed properties, forcing series, process choices and Raven executable settings; outputs include simulated flow and storage as xarray objects or run errors. Spatial and temporal coverage follow the underlying Raven setup, from a basin to a larger distributed model. MIT-licensed source is free through GitHub and Python package channels, with current and versioned documentation. The README warns that version 0.12 changed the interface incompatibly from 0.11, so scripts should pin a compatible release. RavenPy does not supply the native Raven model binary or validated catchment data by itself. It supports multi-run calibration, ensemble prediction and flood or water-supply simulations. The catalogue already contains model-raven for the underlying hydrological framework; this record covers the separate Python orchestration layer. No simulation was launched.
name: RavenPy hydrological model interface
